Revenant.profileName: Revenant maxed-out tier, final (2026-10-01): RTM rules, Unstable Crystal Card's explosion modelled (it kills), bought + skill rolls -- win 98% lost 0% 45,720 dps 4s 565 kills/h (sit 0.3s) 2.3 deaths/h

Scythe Reap.name: Scythe Reap
Scythe Reap.desc:
A multi-strike attack that slices the skin, which can immobilize the enemy for 4 seconds.
Requires a Scythe to use.
Damage is 150+25% per level +2% per Luk.
Skill can be a critical hit.
Grants or refreshes Combo Ready for 4 seconds.
This also applies to autocasts.
Damage is slightly boosted by weapon weight.
Skill has decreasing delay per level.
Base Starting Cooldown is 1 second.
Scythe Reap.summary: Your combo opener: a three-slash hit that turns on Combo Ready for 4 s. Recast it whenever Combo Ready is about to drop.

Reaping Slash.name: Reaping Slash
Reaping Slash.desc:
Deals damage to all targets in a 5x5 cell radius around the caster.
Damage is 110+10% per level +2% per LUK
Extra 5% per Overslash Stack
Skill can be critical.
Grants an Overslash Stack per cast, but
Only goes past 1 if Combo Ready
Finisher Ready instantly maximizes stacks if Combo Ready and already has 1 stack or higher
Overslash stack increases Roaring Overslash and Underworld Rainstorm power
Maximum amount of stacks is 5
Stacks duration is 6 seconds
Base Starting Cooldown is 1.5 seconds
SP Cost: 5 per level.
Requires an extra 5% Current HP per cast
Reaping Slash.summary: Spin attack around you that builds Overslash stacks (max 5, last 6 s). Needs Combo Ready to go past 1 stack; with Finisher Ready up it jumps straight to 5 — and it always ends Finisher Ready. Costs 5% of your current HP.

Hellraiser.name: Hellraiser
Hellraiser.desc:
Strucks weapon to the ground causing strong explosion that damage all enemies around the caster.
Skill can be critical.
Skill activates Finisher Ready for 5s
Damage is 250+15% per level +3% per LUK
Damage is always Fire Element.
Variable cast time is 0.5s
Base starting cooldown is 12 seconds.
Hellraiser.summary: Fire explosion around you that grants Finisher Ready for 5 s. Cast it with 1 Overslash stack, so the next Reaping Slash takes you to 5.

Sweeping Slash.name: Sweeping Slash
Sweeping Slash.desc:
Sweeps the legs with the scythe,
Damage is 200+25% per level +2% per LUK per hit
Skill deals 2 individual hits
Increased to 3 hits if Finisher Ready
Damage greatly reduced outside combos
Skill can be critical
Base Starting Cooldown is 2.5 seconds.
Sweeping Slash.summary: Two-hit filler (three under Finisher Ready) that also refreshes Combo Ready for 3 s. Weak outside a combo.

Haunting Slice.name: Haunting Slice
Haunting Slice.desc:
Quickly reaches and attacks
Damage is fixed based on ATK and Str.
Range is 3+1 cells per level.
20% chance per level to autocast Scythe Reap.
Autocast uses Haunting Slice's skill level.
Starting cooldown is 7 seconds.
Haunting Slice.summary: Dash to the target; at Lv5 it always autocasts Scythe Reap for free — a gap closer that also restarts Combo Ready.

Roaring Overslash.name: Roaring Overslash
Roaring Overslash.desc:
Draws crosses on the skies to cause damage at a range of 7x7.
Damage is 150+15% per level +2% per LUK
Damage reduced if not combo ready
Deals one extra hit per Roaring Stack
Skill can be critical
Base cooldown is 7 seconds.
Requires extra 10% Current SP per cast.
Roaring Overslash.summary: Your finisher: one hit, plus one extra full hit per Overslash stack (6 hits at 5 stacks). Does not use up the stacks. Weaker without Combo Ready. Costs 10% of current SP.

Phantom Slice.name: Phantom Slice
Phantom Slice.desc:
Throws Scythe and Attacks a distant enemy to pull them close to yourself. Can be used on a party member, but won't deal damage.

Damage is 100+20% +2% per Vit.
Range is 3+1 cells per level.
Starting cooldown is 1 second.
Phantom Slice.summary: Ranged scythe throw that pulls the target in. A cheap 1-second-cooldown filler between combos.

Flaming Wave.name: Flaming Wave
Flaming Wave.desc:
Sets flames on the ground and inflicts Burning status to enemies around the targeted enemy.
Damage is 30% per level +3% per INT.
Burning chance is 5% per level
Burning duration is 2.5+0.5s per level
Base Starting Cooldown is 5 seconds
Flaming Wave.summary: Fire line that can set targets Burning. Scales on INT, so weak on a STR/LUK build — only a filler.

Dark Message.name: Dark Message
Dark Message.desc:
Pushes back a targeted enemy 3 cells away. Only Small sized targets are fully damaged by this skill.
Damage is very small and focused on control.
Damage is 10% per level +1% per STR.
Damage is calculated based on MATK insteat of ATK
Enables Combo Ready for 1s per level
Enables Cast Ready for 1s per level
Variable cast time is 0.5s
Fixed cast time is 0.1s
Base Starting Cooldown is 7 seconds
Dark Message.summary: Small push that grants Combo Ready and Cast Ready (variable cast −95%) — used to make Underworld Rainstorm instant.

Underworld Rainstorm.name: Underworld Rainstorm
Underworld Rainstorm.desc:
Summons a rain of rays from the underworld to continuously strike enemies in an 11x11 AoE for a duration.
Damage is 2% per Level +1% per 2 LUK and INT
Extra 4% per Overslash Stack
Skill duration is 3 seconds.
Enemies are hit every 0.2 seconds.
Variable cast time is 5s
Fixed cast time is 0.5s
Cooldown is 12 seconds.
Cast can't be interrupted and skill never misses.
Defenses halved during casting
Requires a Shadow Orb to cast.
Underworld Rainstorm.summary: Rain of hits on an 11x11 area for 3 s, +4% per Overslash stack. Its 5 s cast is cut by Dark Message's Cast Ready or removed by Royal Scythe.

Darkside Shadow.name: Darkside Shadow
Darkside Shadow.desc:
Summons your shadow to repeat your normal attacks, allowing use of the
Double Attack skill with a Scythe.
Adds 2% per DEX Scaling to all Physical skills
Underworld Rainstorm bonus is halved
Duration is 15 seconds per level.
Cooldown is 60 seconds.
Double Attack chance is 10% per level.
Darkside Shadow.summary: Pre-fight buff, 150 s: your shadow gives normal attacks a 100% Double Attack chance, and every physical skill gains +2% damage per DEX.

True Sight.name: True Sight
True Sight.desc:
Focus to improve
Current combat capabilities for a short time.
Duration is 60 seconds.
Starting Cooldown is 80 seconds.
Increases all stats by 3 for duration.
Increases hit by 3 and crit by 3 per level.
True Sight.summary: Pre-fight buff, 60 s: +3 to all stats, +30 HIT and +30 crit; also +20% to every weapon attack's ratio (server code).

Vampire Mark.name: Vampire Mark
Vampire Mark.desc:
Imbodies blood into an ally or self to allow leeching physical damage.
Duration is 60s at Lv1 -5s per level
Duration is 40s at Lv5.
Base Starting Cooldown is 60 seconds
Leeching chance is 10% per level
Leeching power is 3% per level
Doesn't work with magic damage
Vampire Mark.summary: Pre-fight buff, 40 s: physical hits have a 50% chance to heal you for 15% of the damage. Feeds the Ominous Presence shield.

Shadow Parry.name: Shadow Parry
Shadow Parry.desc:
Blocks damage from physical attack using a Scythe. When successfully blocking an attack, caster will be forced to pause momentarily.
Requires a Scythe.
Block chance is 10 + 2% per level.
Requires 5% extra Max SP per cast.
Duration is 20+10s per level
Shadow Parry.summary: Pre-fight buff, 120 s: blocks 30% of physical hits (normal attacks and weapon skills) outright.

Burning Scythe.name: Burning Scythe
Burning Scythe.desc:
Endows your own weapon with Fire element for the skill's duration.
Duration is 30 seconds per level.
Variable cast time is 1s
Fixed cast time is 1s
Burning Scythe.summary: Fire endow, cast before the pull only when Fire beats your weapon's element on the target (Holy monsters, for a Neutral or Holy scythe).

Ominous Presence.name: Ominous Presence
Ominous Presence.desc:
Increases Lecching effects and Overheals of Scythes.
OverHeal (Scythe HP Leech):
Leeching HP with full health converts into a Shield
Duration: 30s (refreshes on new Overheal).
Shield Max: MaxHP + (10% x Lv) x (STR + 2xLUK + BaseLv) x Leech Power.
Leech Power uses percentage points (5% = 5).
Requires positive Leech Power.
Conversion: 8% per Skill Lv against a single target,
4% per Skill Lv when the hit strikes several targets.
Ominous Presence.summary: Passive: leech that would overheal you becomes a shield (80% of the overheal), up to Max HP + your STR/LUK/level times Leech Power. This is what keeps a low-HP Revenant alive.

Satsujin.profileName: Satsujin farm, maxed-out tier A (2026-10-01): 10 endgame areas, free for all except +10, bought + skill rolls; from standard-rings -- win 98% lost 0% 79,042 dps 2s 778 kills/h (sit 0.5s) 0.3 deaths/h

Shadow Slash.name: Shadow Slash
Shadow Slash.desc:
Shadow Slash dashes to a target and attempts a critical hit 3 times.
Damage is 200+15% per level +1% per LUK
Bonus Crit Rate is 5+ 5 per level
Only Right Hand Weapon ATK is used
Requires a Dagger or Sword equipped
Damage increases by 5% per Improve Dodge level while under Hallucination Walk
Base Starting Cooldown is 4 seconds.
Shadow Slash.summary: Dash-in opener: three crit attempts on the target. Puts you in melee instantly.

New Moon.name: New Moon
New Moon.desc:
Moon-only skill:
Attacks nearby enemies and enters
New Moon, hiding the caster for 5 seconds.
The state can be maintained until attacking.
Costs 1 SP per second while hiding.
Halves damage taken while invisible.
Damage: 150 +30% per level +5% per AGI.
Focus: +5% per level per Focus.
Variable cast time is 1s
Base Starting Cooldown is 5 seconds.
Loses Focus stacks if autocasting.
New Moon.summary: Starts the Moon combo: hits around you and turns you invisible (halves damage taken) until you attack. Scales with AGI and Elemental Focus.

Full Moon.name: Full Moon
Full Moon.desc:
Moon-only skill:
Can only be used while in New Moon.
Ends New Moon and damages nearby enemies.
Has a high chance to inflict Blind.
Damage: 250 +50% per level +8% per AGI.
Focus: +10% per level per Focus.
Grants Combo Ready for 5 seconds.
Requires extra 10% Current SP per cast.
Full Moon.summary: Only from New Moon: the big hit of the combo (AGI and Focus scaling), and it grants Combo Ready.

Million Stab.name: Million Stab
Million Stab.desc:
Rapidly stabs the target and nearby enemies for physical damage.
Damage: 20 +5% per level +1% per AGI.
Combo Ready adds +1% per DEX.
Does not consume Combo Ready.
Variable cast time decreases with level: 1s to 0.1s
Starting cooldown is 5 seconds.
Million Stab.summary: Rapid stabs; only cast under Combo Ready, where DEX adds to it.

Thousand Arms.name: Thousand Arms
Thousand Arms.desc:
Spins quickly hitting all enemies around multiple times.
Hits a 7x7 area around the caster.
Damage is 200+20% per level +5% per Agi.
Base cooldown is 3 seconds.
Requires extra 5% Current HP to cast
Thousand Arms.summary: 7x7 spin filler between Moon combos; costs 5% current HP.

Dragon Omamori.name: Dragon Omamori
Dragon Omamori.desc:
Applies a talisman to the target and deals physical damage.
The talisman can be detonated by
Omamori Jutsu for stronger damage.
Talismans last 50 seconds.
Only one talisman per target.
Apply Damage: 50 +10% per level.
Explosion: 200 +50% per level +2% per DEX.
Combo Ready adds +5% per STR.
Requires an extra 5% Max SP per talisman.
Variable cast time is 0.5s
Dragon Omamori.summary: Puts a talisman on the target (cast under Combo Ready); Omamori Jutsu detonates it.

Omamori Jutsu.name: Omamori Jutsu
Omamori Jutsu.desc:
Activates and detonates caster's Dragon Omamori and
Binding Omamori on screen.
Base Starting Cooldown is 5 seconds
Activates Invisibility when activated
Omamori Jutsu.summary: Detonates your Dragon Omamori talisman for big damage, and makes you invisible — which lets Full Moon follow.

Kawarimi.name: Kawarimi
Kawarimi.desc:
Enables Kawarimi status ensuring the caster to automatically dodges a set number of attacks. Each special dodge is followed by a backward movement of
1 cell. Has a 20s cooldown.
[Lv 1]: Lasts 2 seconds, 1 Dodge
[Lv 2]: Lasts 2,5 seconds, 1 Dodge
[Lv 3]: Lasts 3 seconds, 2 Dodges
[Lv 4]: Lasts 3,5 seconds, 2 Dodges
[Lv 5]: Lasts 4 seconds, 3 Dodges
Kawarimi.summary: Dodge: the next physical hit misses and you step back a cell.

Back Stab.name: Back Stab
Back Stab.desc:
teleports the caster behind the enemy to deal damage.
Damage is 150+5% per level +1% per AGI.
Requires a Sword or Dagger equipped
Requires 5% extra Current SP to cast.
Starting Cooldown is 3 seconds.
Enemy's back must be unobstructed to use
Single-Wielding a Dagger:
AGI bonus is tripled
Bonus per skill level tripled
Extra 5% scaling per level of Improve Dodge

Moonlight Stance.name: Moonlight Stance
Moonlight Stance.desc:
Prepares your stance to operate with the moonlight. You can use the
Moon skills while this skill is activated.
Increases also your MaxHP.
HP Bonus is 2% per level.
Requires extra 50% Current SP to cast.
Moonlight Stance.summary: Pre-fight stance: required for every Moon skill, and +2% Max HP per level.

Seven Winds.name: Seven Winds
Seven Winds.desc:
Summons a wind that will enchant the caster's attacks for 5 minutes with an elemental property based on the level of the casted skill.
[Lv 1]: Earth (50 SP)
[Lv 2]: Wind (50 SP)
[Lv 3]: Water (50 SP)
[Lv 4]: Fire (50 SP)
[Lv 5]: Ghost (50 SP)
[Lv 6]: Dark (50 SP)
[Lv 7]: Holy (50 SP)
Seven Winds.summary: Pre-fight endow: picks the element that hits the target hardest for 5 minutes.

Hallucination Walk.name: Hallucination Walk
Hallucination Walk.desc:
Increases caster's speed to the maximum, increases FLEE and certain chance to avoid magic attacks.
Has a duration of 25+5s per level
Has a cooldown of 120 seconds
Flee bonus is 10 per lv and 5% per level to avoid magic damage.
Requires a Shadow Orb to cast

Magic Pierce.name: Magic Pierce
Magic Pierce.desc:
Ignores part of the enemy's MDEF against spells
Can be used on others.
Magic Defense Penetration is 3 per level
Defense Penetration is 1 per level and works on autocasts.
Variable cast time is 3s
Fixed cast time is 1s

Kingslayer.profileName: Kingslayer endgame farming (2026-09-30): unrestricted gear search over 10 areas (MVPs out, areas weighted equally), kills/h with deaths and stalls penalised

Bishop's Tax.name: Bishop's Tax
Bishop's Tax.desc:
Attacks and taxes the enemy defenses, increasing damage taken.
Damage is 200+30% per level + 2% per Dex
Cooldown is 10 seconds
Enemies hit receive 15% extra damage
Damage bonus duration is 3s to 12s by level
Requires 25% extra Max HP to cast
Bishop's Tax.summary: Hit that makes the target take 15% more damage for up to 12 s; cast right before Shield Boomerang into King's Chains. Costs 25% Max HP.

Shield Boomerang.name: Shield Boomerang
Shield Boomerang.desc:
Throws shield quickly at an enemy
Damage is 200+20% per level +1% per vit
Damage is improved by shield refine/weight
Base Starting Cooldown is 3 seconds
Shield Boomerang.summary: Shield throw that opens the King's Chains combo (x1.5 with the Bulwark Gem).

King's Chains.name: King's Chains
King's Chains.desc:
Throws a rebounding shield 4 times at an enemy to deal damage.
Damage is 200+10% per level +1% per VIT/STR
Damage is based on shield refine/weight.
Weapon ATK does not apply; only your base ATK and the shield count.
Extra 1% per VIT per Duel Counter
Extra 1% per Soft DEF and Hard DEF
Skill ignores flee
Requires a Shield.
Variable cast time is 0.4s
Fixed cast time is 0.1s
Base Starting Cooldown is 8 seconds
Requires extra 15% Current SP
Requires 1 Duel Counter to cast
Finisher Ready: extra 30% per missing HP %
King's Chains.summary: The main hit: four shield throws, scaling with VIT, STR and your Duel Counters; spends one counter.

Rook's Smash.name: Rook's Smash
Rook's Smash.desc:
Smashes a small area of enemies and knock them back.
Dealing 2 hits, with full damage on each.
Usable with any weapon.
Requires a Shield equipped.
Slides you onto the target, then pushes enemies away from where you land.
Additional Damage equal 1/5 HP
Damage is 150+5% per level + 1% per Str.
Extra 25% Damage per Duel Counter
Generates up to 3 Duel Counters under Duel Stance.
Base Starting Cooldown is 8 seconds
Rook's Smash.summary: Slide onto the target for 2-3 hits plus a fifth of your current HP as damage; fills Duel Counters to 3.

Decoy.name: Decoy
Decoy.desc:
Dashes back and hides while creating a clone that explodes in an area dealing damage to enemies
Damage is 200+25% per level +1% per INT and LUK.
Variable cast time is 1.5s
Base Starting Cooldown is 8 seconds.

Duel Stance.name: Duel Stance
Duel Stance.desc:
Increases your Duel Counter when you receive physical attacks. The
Duel Counters can be used for boost
Strenght of other Duelist skills according to VIT. consumes some SP at regular time interval to stay active.
Increase Max HP by 2% per level
Counter chance is 25+15% per level
Maximum Amount of Counters is 10.
Learning this skill disabled Flip Coin
Fixed cast time is 0.5s
Duel Stance.summary: Pre-fight stance: physical hits you take build Duel Counters; +Max HP.

King's Fortress.name: King's Fortress
King's Fortress.desc:
Enchants the shield with a unique aura that improves the flow of energy of the caster depending on the skill level used.
Requires a Shield.
[Lv 1]: Regen 1% HP every 2 seconds.
[Lv 2]: Regen 1% SP every 2 seconds.
[Lv 3]: King's Chains and Shield Boomerang
Extra +1% per STR and 2% per VIT scaling damage.
Fortress Bonus Effects:
[Lv 1]: Cover Ally reduces damage taken by 75%
[Lv 2]: Cover Ally receives Hallucination Walk
[Lv 3]: Cover Ally receives Endure effect
Duration is 5 minutes
Variable cast time is 10s
Cooldown is 60 seconds
King's Fortress.summary: Pre-fight shield aura; at Lv3 it adds STR and VIT scaling to King's Chains and Shield Boomerang.

Knight's Regen.name: Knight's Regen
Knight's Regen.desc:
Recovers a percentage of HP to self and all party members on screen every 5 seconds. Has no effect on
Undead elemental players.
Recovery amount is 1+1% Max HP per level.
Requires 50% Max SP as extra cost.
Duration is 60+60s per level.
Variable cast time is 4s
Fixed cast time is 2s
Cooldown is 60 seconds
Knight's Regen.summary: Pre-fight regen: heals a share of Max HP every 5 s for minutes.

Bishop's Guard.name: Bishop's Guard
Bishop's Guard.desc:
Increases MaxHP and physical defense from VIT of all party members including caster.
Duration is 5 minutes
Bonus HP is 500 per level.
Bonus Vit Defense is 10% per level.
Variable cast time is 3.5s
Fixed cast time is 1.5s
Requires 10% Max HP to cast
Bishop's Guard.summary: Pre-fight buff: +500 Max HP per level and more VIT defence.

Reflect Shield.name: Reflect Shield
Reflect Shield.desc:
Reflect a certain amount of damage back to the enemy after they inflict damage with short Physical Ranged attacks.
Requires Shield.
Damage reflected is 10+4% per level
Reflect Shield.summary: Pre-fight buff: sends a share of melee damage you take back at the attacker.

Ignores part of the enemy's MDEF against spells

ASPD penalty according to the skill's level. Casting this skill again cancels the Defender status.
Requires Shield.
10% Ranged Reduction per Level.

Damage is Greatly boosted on marked targets.
Cooldown is 2.5s-0.1s per level.
Requires both hands equipped to use

Definitive Dagger.name: Definitive Dagger
Definitive Dagger.desc:
Attacks an enemy with quick hits and perfect preparation.
Damage is boosted with dual daggers.
Damage is 100+30% per level +2% per Agi.
Night Wound: +50%+1% per Dex
Hit bonus is 5 per level. Range is 3.
Costs an extra 3% Current SP to use.
Base starting cooldown is 1 second.

Dark Claw.name: Dark Claw
Dark Claw.desc:
Leaves a painful wound on the enemy and removes melee physical damage reflect effects for 5 seconds. during this time melee physical damage reflect effects are not available and the enemy will receive 2% per level more damage from melee physical attacks.
Cooldown is 90 seconds.

Weapon Blocking.name: Weapon Blocking
Weapon Blocking.desc:
Has a chance to cancel enemy's short range damage when skill is active. If an enemy's attack has been canceled, you'll gain the Counter state for 5 seconds and Counter Skills can be used until this state ends.
Requires Dual-Wielding any pair of weapons
Status Cannot be canceled manually.
Blocking Chance is 15%+2% per level.
Duration is 120 seconds

Rising Wings.name: Rising Wings
Rising Wings.desc:
Increases Weapon Damage by
Bonding with the Raven.
Quadruples Sword+Dagger Auto-Raven chance
Overall Attack Bonus is 1% per level
Costs an extra 50% Current SP to cast.
Requires a Raven.

Fury.name: Fury
Fury.desc:
Increases caster's power to the maximum, increasing CRIT for the duration and slowing SP regeneration.
Enables Executioner Class Skills.
Has a duration of 20+10s per level
Has a cooldown of 60 seconds
Increases Sonic Blow Base Damage by 50%
Increases Impact Tooth Base Damage by 50%
CRIT bonus is 1 per level
Bonus is doubled with Katars.
Requires a Shadow Orb to Cast

Hallucination Walk.name: Hallucination Walk
Hallucination Walk.desc:
Increases caster's speed to the maximum, increases FLEE and certain chance to avoid magic attacks.
Has a duration of 25+5s per level
Has a cooldown of 120 seconds
Flee bonus is 10 per lv and 5% per level to avoid magic damage.
Requires a Shadow Orb to cast

Enchant Poison.name: Enchant Poison
Enchant Poison.desc:
Temporarily coats your equipped weapon with the Poison element. Poison coated weapons have a chance of inflicting the target with the Poison status.
Chance is 3 + 1% per level on normal attacks, 0% vs bosses
Skills do not roll the Poison chance
All physical attacks become poison element
Duration is 30 seconds +15s per level
Requires extra 50% Max SP to cast

Magic Pierce.name: Magic Pierce
Magic Pierce.desc:
Ignores part of the enemy's MDEF against spells
Can be used on others.
Magic Defense Penetration is 3 per level
Defense Penetration is 1 per level and works on autocasts.
Variable cast time is 3s
Fixed cast time is 1s
